description: Seller Payment-Acceptance Check: is your x402 server turning away paying agents? We probe YOUR route with a throwaway, unfunded key (no money can move): a fresh payment must reach your facilitator; a payment echoing an older 402 (changed description/example, changed timeout) must not be refused; an x402 v1 X-PAYMENT must not be ignored silently. Verdict ACCEPTS_GOOD_MONEY / REFUSES_GOOD_MONEY / SERVES_UNPAID / NO_VALID_402 with each problem and the exact fix. OMENZ found this leak on its own server: a funded repeat buyer was refused 4 times. Max 5 requests to your URL. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/seller/acceptance-check, $0.05 via x402.)
